responsibility: Defines the core compile-time target description for MicroBlaze: ABI register numbers, default target masks, endianness defaults, assembler and linker specs, predefined target macros, DWARF/debug mappings, section and object-format conventions, startup and library specs, and numerous backend macros consumed by generic GCC code and the MicroBlaze implementation. It is the central target header that describes the architecture and toolchain interface rather than implementing RTL transformations directly.
same_name_distinction: This is the central target header that publishes MicroBlaze macros, ABI/register-number constants, assembler/linker specs, section conventions, and extern declarations consumed by the rest of GCC and by microblaze.cc. Unlike microblaze.cc it is declarative rather than hook implementation code, unlike microblaze.md it is not the RTL machine-description pattern file, and unlike microblaze.opt it does not define the target's option table.
